SELECT p.id AS player_id, p.name AS player_name, e.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(*) AS goals FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id JOIN player p ON p.id = e.player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = e.team_id WHERE e.event_type = 'GOAL'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, e.team_id, t.name ORDER BY goals DESC, p.name ASC

SELECT p.id AS player_id, p.name AS player_name, e.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(*) AS assists FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id JOIN player p ON p.id = e.related_player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = e.team_id WHERE e.event_type = 'GOAL' AND e.related_player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, e.team_id, t.name ORDER BY assists DESC, p.name ASC

SELECT p.id AS player_id, p.name AS player_name, a.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.fixture_id) AS appearances FROM fixture_appearance a JOIN fixture f ON f.id = a.fixture_id JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id JOIN player p ON p.id = a.player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = a.team_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, a.team_id, t.name ORDER BY appearances DESC, p.name ASC

WITH results AS ( SELECT f.home_team_id AS team_id, f.home_score AS goals_for, f.away_score AS goals_against, CASE WHEN f.home_score > f.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won, CASE WHEN f.home_score = f.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drawn, CASE WHEN f.home_score < f.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lost FROM fixture f JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id WHERE f.home_score IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT f.away_team_id, f.away_score, f.home_score, CASE WHEN f.away_score > f.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN f.away_score = f.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN f.away_score < f.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM fixture f JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id WHERE f.home_score IS NOT NULL
), cards AS ( SELECT e.team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'YELLOW_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yellow_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'RED_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red_cards, -SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'YELLOW_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 3 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'RED_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fair_play_points FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id WHERE e.event_type IN ('YELLOW_CARD', 'RED_CARD')
GROUP BY e.team_id ) SELECT st.team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(r.team_id) AS played, COALESCE(SUM(r.won), 0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(r.drawn), 0) AS drawn, COALESCE(SUM(r.lost), 0) AS lost, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_for), 0) AS goals_for, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_against), 0) AS goals_against, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_for), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_against), 0) AS goal_difference, COALESCE(c.yellow_cards, 0) AS yellow_cards, COALESCE(c.red_cards, 0) AS red_cards, COALESCE(c.fair_play_points, 0) AS fair_play_points, COALESCE(SUM(r.won), 0) * 3 + COALESCE(SUM(r.drawn), 0) AS points FROM season_team st JOIN season s ON s.id = st.season_id JOIN team t ON t.id = st.team_id LEFT JOIN results r ON r.team_id = st.team_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.team_id = st.team_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND st.season_id = #{filter.seasonId} AND s.competition_id = #{filter.competitionId} GROUP BY st.team_id, t.name, c.yellow_cards, c.red_cards, c.fair_play_points ORDER BY points DESC, goal_difference DESC, goals_for DESC, fair_play_points DESC, won DESC, team_name ASC

WITH results AS ( SELECT f.home_team_id AS team_id, f.home_score AS goals_for, f.away_score AS goals_against, CASE WHEN f.home_score > f.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won, CASE WHEN f.home_score = f.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drawn, CASE WHEN f.home_score < f.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lost FROM fixture f JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id WHERE f.home_score IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT f.away_team_id, f.away_score, f.home_score, CASE WHEN f.away_score > f.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN f.away_score = f.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN f.away_score < f.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM fixture f JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id WHERE f.home_score IS NOT NULL
), cards AS ( SELECT e.team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'YELLOW_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yellow_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'RED_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red_cards, -SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'YELLOW_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 3 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'RED_CARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fair_play_points FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id JOIN season s ON s.id = f.season_id WHERE e.event_type IN ('YELLOW_CARD', 'RED_CARD')
GROUP BY e.team_id ) SELECT gt.team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(r.team_id) AS played, COALESCE(SUM(r.won), 0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(r.drawn), 0) AS drawn, COALESCE(SUM(r.lost), 0) AS lost, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_for), 0) AS goals_for, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_against), 0) AS goals_against, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_for), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_against), 0) AS goal_difference, COALESCE(c.yellow_cards, 0) AS yellow_cards, COALESCE(c.red_cards, 0) AS red_cards, COALESCE(c.fair_play_points, 0) AS fair_play_points, COALESCE(SUM(r.won), 0) * 3 + COALESCE(SUM(r.drawn), 0) AS points FROM group_team gt JOIN competition_group cg ON cg.id = gt.group_id JOIN stage stg ON stg.id = cg.stage_id JOIN season s ON s.id = stg.season_id JOIN team t ON t.id = gt.team_id LEFT JOIN results r ON r.team_id = gt.team_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.team_id = gt.team_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND gt.group_id = #{filter.groupId} AND cg.stage_id = #{filter.stageId} AND stg.season_id = #{filter.seasonId} AND s.competition_id = #{filter.competitionId} GROUP BY gt.team_id, t.name, c.yellow_cards, c.red_cards, c.fair_play_points ORDER BY points DESC, goal_difference DESC, goals_for DESC, fair_play_points DESC, won DESC, team_name ASC
